decisions.reason: The source concerns no-referral rewards appearing in NFT metadata attributes, not the reward summary shown in the NFT detail view.
Reward attribution does not change whether NFT metadata and asset endpoints resolve successfully.

The candidate already requires all ticket and commission totals from completed mints to be represented accurately, and its prior history explicitly identifies the no-referral path; message 622 reports continued failure rather than a new requirement value.
The source does not change which successfully minted NFTs must appear on the dashboard.
The source names the leaderboard and NFT attributes, not the dashboard reward summary.
No public mint, prize-pool, referral, or draw-counter rule is changed by the NFT-attribute requirement.
Reward values in NFT attributes are distinct from displaying NFT images, covers, and asset information.
The source does not alter the NFT's permanent referral-code identity or which referral code is displayed in its attributes.
The runtime report does not request any change to About-page copy or resolve its reward-delivery ambiguity.
No NFT transfer behavior or transferred reward state is discussed in the source.
The source concerns tickets and commissions, not badge triggers, destinations, or award rules.

The candidate already requires random commission allocation for successful no-referral mints; message 622 reports that the existing behavior still is not reflected and does not change the allocation rule or resolve the first-mint ambiguity.
